svg.text: The upper pad is drawn squeezed, 1.7 thick; cut it from 2 mm foam.

svg.text: It holds the module on the cell and keeps its pads off the cell.

svg.text: Upper pad: 16 x 19 from 2 mm closed-cell foam, with a 4 mm hole

svg.text: centred 3 mm in from one short end, over the status LED.
